description: Search Wikipedia articles by full-text query. Returns ranked results with plain-text titles, short descriptions, Wikidata QIDs, snippets (HTML stripped), page IDs, and word counts — the description is usually enough to tell same-named articles apart without a summary call per result. When Wikipedia has a spelling correction for the query, it is returned as suggestion. Best when the exact article title is unknown or when multiple articles on a topic are needed. Pass a result title to wikipedia_get_summary, wikipedia_get_article, or wikipedia_get_sections for follow-up reads. Use offset to page beyond the first result page. Supports all Wikipedia language editions.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (default 10, max 50). Must be a positive integer.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination (default 0). Pass the nextOffset from a previous response to fetch the next page; limit still governs the per-page size. An offset past the total match count returns an empty result array, not an error. Wikipedia serves no result past 10,000, so an offset at or beyond that fails — narrow the query instead.

query.description: Search query (e.g. "Python programming language"). Must not be empty.

name: wikipedia_search_articles

cap.description: The result ceiling that cut this page — the search window. Present only alongside truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `empty_query`: The query is an empty string, which Wikipedia reads as a missing parameter. `offset_too_large`: The offset is at or past the search window, which has no continuation. `invalid_language`: The language is not a valid BCP 47 code, or names a Wikipedia edition that does not exist. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset to request the next page. Present only when more results remain — pass it back as offset to continue; absent at the end of results.

notice.description: Guidance when no results matched (naming the spelling suggestion when there is one), when the end of results was reached while paging, when the page was cut at the search window, or when descriptions and Wikidata QIDs could not be loaded for the page. Absent on ordinary result pages.

offset.description: The result offset applied to this page (echo of the input).

description.description: Short description of the article subject (e.g. "General-purpose programming language"). Absent when the article has none, or when descriptions could not be loaded for the page (see notice).

pageid.description: Stable numeric Wikipedia page ID — a durable reference for cross-referencing or de-duplication. Not a tool input; pass the title to follow-up tools.

snippet.description: Plain-text search snippet with matched terms.

wikibase_item.description: Wikidata QID (e.g. "Q28865") for chaining into wikidata-mcp-server. Absent when the article has no Wikidata item, or when it could not be loaded for the page (see notice).

shown.description: Number of results returned on this page.

suggestion.description: Wikipedia's spelling correction for the query, when it has one (e.g. "einstein" for "einstien"). Re-run with it as query to search the corrected spelling. Absent when the query has no likely misspelling.

truncated.description: True when this page was cut at Wikipedia's 10,000-result search window and totalCount matches remain that no offset can reach. Absent on every other page, including a genuine last page.

title: Search Wikipedia
